description: viber hooks: injects the viber manifest at session start, and gates ExitPlanMode on the planner skill's own review round. The SessionStart hook writes hooks/content/manifest.md verbatim into the main session's context once per session (source == "resume" excluded, since the prior injection reloads with the transcript) and falls back to the version banner alone when that file is empty or unreadable. The plan gate is armed only when the current plan-mode episode shows BOTH the planner skill running (Skill tool_use or a typed /planner, plugin prefix included) and a Write/Edit of a plans/*.md file; anything else - plain plan mode, another plugin's plan flow, an exit in a session that already built a plan - passes untouched. When armed it allows ExitPlanMode only after a viber:planner-review dispatch that followed the last plan write returned 'VERDICT: PASS', with the plan file untouched since that verdict (mtime vs. the transcript timestamp). Both hooks fail open: any parse miss or unreadable input allows.
